cohort: Women with early cervical cancer (FIGO stages IA2 and IB1) who underwent laparoscopic radical trachelectomy and pelvic lymphadenectomy.
finding: Laparoscopic radical trachelectomy and pelvic lymphadenectomy demonstrated acceptable surgical and oncological outcomes with no recurrences or deaths after a median follow-up of 4.4 years, and resulted in two healthy babies among those who attempted conception.
mod_finding: All two pregnancies resulted in cesarean deliveries due to premature pre-labor rupture of membranes.
